description:
Create a thread — a chain of sequential posts — on twitter, threads, bluesky, or mastodon.

Provide at least 2 ordered entries in 'posts' (max 25). Each entry has its own content, an optional single media item (mediaItems, max 1 per entry), and optional per-platform text via platformContent.

Scheduling: scheduledFor (ISO 8601) or publishNow: true; omit both to schedule for now.

WARNING: this CONSUMES POST QUOTA — one post per thread entry (a 5-entry thread uses 5 posts of quota).

Thread platforms only: twitter, threads, bluesky, mastodon. Other platforms are rejected. Use platformSettings for thread-wide options (e.g. mastodon visibility). config (postDelay, continueOnError, maxRetries) is accepted for compatibility, but the per-platform chain delay is fixed and postDelay is not honored.

First Comment (auto-plug): pass firstComment (plain string, comments the root post) or firstComments ([{target, text}]) to auto-post comments after the thread publishes. target 0 = entry 1 (the root); target i = entry i+1, so max target = number of entries - 1. Thread-targeted comments (target > 0) deliver on twitter/threads/bluesky only; on mastodon only the target-0 comment applies. Comments are text and links only. Limits: twitter=280, bluesky=300, threads=500 characters; mastodon has no fixed limit. A failed comment never fails the thread - check get_post's platforms[].firstComments for delivery status.

The response includes the thread id and a single postId (the whole chain publishes from ONE post document) — use get_post on that postId for live status.

brandId.description: Workspace / brand id to post under (from an account's brandId).

continueOnError.description: Keep posting later entries if one fails (default false).

postDelay.description: Milliseconds between thread entries (accepted but NOT honored; the chain delay is fixed per platform).

firstComment.description: Auto-post this text as the first comment on the ROOT entry after the thread publishes (shorthand for firstComments: [{target: 0, text}]).

firstComments.description: Auto-posted comments per thread entry ([{target, text}]). See the First Comment section of the description.

target.description: 0 = entry 1 (the root, default); i = entry i+1. Max = entries - 1. Targets > 0 deliver on twitter/threads/bluesky only.

text.description: Comment text - links allowed, no media.

platformSettings.description: Thread-wide per-platform overrides keyed by platform name (e.g. { mastodon: { visibility: 'unlisted' } }).

platforms.description: Target platforms (twitter, threads, bluesky, mastodon). Strings or objects with accountId.

accountId.description: Specific connected account id (from list_accounts). Omit to use the default account.

platform.description: Platform name: twitter, threads, bluesky, or mastodon.

posts.description: Ordered thread entries (2-25). Each becomes one post in the chain.

mediaItems.description: Media for this entry — at most 1 media item per entry.

platformContent.description: Per-platform text override for THIS entry, keyed by platform (e.g. { twitter: '...' }); falls back to content.

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule the thread (5 minutes to 90 days out).

name: create_thread
title: Create Thread
